convertedFacts.logicSummary:
Inputs:
- principal: "Loan", currency, starts at 500000, 0 to 5000000, step 10000
- rate: "Rate", percent, starts at 9, 0 to 20, step 0.1
- years: "Years", integer, starts at 20, 1 to 30, step 1
- fee: "Processing", currency, starts at 5000, 0 to 50000, step 500
- gst: "GST", given percent, 18
- cess: "Cess", given percent, 1
- dollar: "Dollar", live number from rates.rate, now 0
- prepay: "Prepay", toggle, starts off
Outputs:
- emi: "EMI", currency = principal * monthlyRate * (1 + monthlyRate) ^ months / ((1 + monthlyRate) ^ months - 1)
- monthlyRate: "Monthly rate", number = rate / 12 / 100
- months: "Months", integer = years * 12
- total: "Total paid", currency = emi * months + fee * (1 + gst / 100 + cess / 100) - prepay
- inDollars: "In dollars", currency, in USD = total / dollar

  - hero #block-4-0 ref total

  - metric #block-5-0 ref months
  - metric #block-5-1 ref total
  - metric #block-5-2 ref emi
  - metric #block-5-3 ref months

  - slider #auto-input-2 ref years
  - slider #auto-input-3 ref fee
  - toggle #auto-input-7 ref prepay
- section #auto-outputs
